notes.title: Playtest update 26/6/25 0.6.23
notes.notes:
Most likely last patch before release of demo.
A few fixes and improvements

QOL IMPROVEMENTS
* Separated Refuel Station and Repair station in town
* Added zoom level UI
* Added fuel range visualization in Fuel store

GAMPLAY
* Experimental adjustment on ship range calculation. Aimed at rewarding low efficiency/fuel capacity ships and lessen the reward on bigger ships. Adding fuel efficiency and bigger fuel tanks resaulted in an exponential growth. (left curve before, right curve after)

FIXES
* Fixed shadow having wrong rotations on death animation in card fight
* Made it impossible to save while in a fight
* Fixed Enemy Losing all energy when playing a fire extinguish card
* Fixed shadow artifact on enemy ships on map
* Fixed spending money on repair shop wouldn't play coin animation
* Fixed bug that was considering all generated towns as part of "Lategame", spawning strong enemies at early game and rare items at shops
* fixed regrouped ships not inheriting current port from new commander

notes.title: Playtest update 22/6/25 0.6.22
notes.notes:
* Added UI for switching controlled ship

* When switching control to a new ship camera will follow it until manually moved

* Tweaked map UI

* Fixed Regrouping ship thinking it's part of the group before it actually Regroups with fleet

* Added degree text to Line marker

* Fixed circle lagging behind when moving marker of Map Marker Editor

* Bought merchandise from Munition shop will now prioritize compatible ships when looking for an inventory to place themselves

* Changed landing logic. Won't visit town the instant the ship touches down, will need to press extra "Open Hatch" button to visit town. Repair/Refuel wont happen unless ship is on 0 altitude.

notes.title: Playtest update 19/6/25 0.6.21
notes.notes:
A few fixes
* Fixed the "Evaluation" event having wrong text
* Fixed prologue completion not being reset when deleting saves
* Fixed enemy investigation position not being saved in save file

notes.title: Playtest from version 0.6 released
notes.notes: [p]The past couple for months after releasing the original demo for Metal Coffin I've managed to gather a lot of feedback and got to see a lot of the shortcomings of the game.[/p][p]The 0.6 update aims to fix a lot of those and give the game some identity.[/p][p]To anyone who gets to try it I'd love to hear your thoughts.[/p][p]Full release of the demo build is expected in upcoming weeks.[/p]
